Fny Managed Accounts Has Trimmed Holding in Johnson & Johnson Ord (JNJ) as Market Valuation Declined; As Celgene (CELG) Market Value Declined, Maryland Capital Management Increased Its Holding
May 1, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Maryland Capital Management increased its stake in Celgene Corp (CELG) by 13.96% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Maryland Capital Management bought 11,752 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.30% with the market. The institutional investor held 95,949 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.01 million, up from 84,197 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Maryland Capital Management who had been investing in Celgene Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $65.61B market cap company. The stock increased 0.14% or $0.12 during the last trading session, reaching $87.22. About 686,414 shares traded. Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) has declined 31.28% since May 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.83% the S&P500.
